text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan delivered a spectacular run! 
...Yet after the race, neither reporters 
nor fans offered any praise, nor even 
spared her a glance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, on the train ride home, the 
Trainer momentarily loses sight of Aston 
Machan right beside them. Was it just a 
daydream...?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While the Trainer sensed an unsettling 
atmosphere, Aston Machan invited them to 
go flower viewing. Coughing softly, she 
began to speak.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Next time, she wants to run a race that 
draws more eyes than anyone else's. That's 
why... she wants to run in the Sprinters 
Stakes, where she ran and received cheers 
last year.
